question:
A patient after surgery suddenly becomes breathless with chest pain and a fast pulse. The nurse should:

सर्जरी के बाद रोगी को अचानक साँस की तकलीफ, छाती में दर्द और तेज़ नाड़ी होती है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Give oxygen and keep the patient still, then report at once
ऑक्सीजन दें, रोगी को स्थिर रखें और तुरंत सूचना दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Oxygen, stillness and urgent reporting are needed for a suspected pulmonary embolism

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give a large dose of sedative
बड़ी मात्रा में शामक दें: Sedation can mask deterioration and depress breathing

B — Ask the patient to walk to the window
रोगी को खिड़की तक चलने को कहें: Walking can worsen the embolism

C — Massage the legs firmly
पैरों की कसकर मालिश करें: Leg massage can dislodge more clot

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Pulmonary embolism can be fatal within minutes, so act without delay
option_1:
Give a large dose of sedative
बड़ी मात्रा में शामक दें
option_2:
Ask the patient to walk to the window
रोगी को खिड़की तक चलने को कहें
option_3:
Massage the legs firmly
पैरों की कसकर मालिश करें
option_4:
Give oxygen and keep the patient still, then report at once
ऑक्सीजन दें, रोगी को स्थिर रखें और तुरंत सूचना दें

question:
A patient after a bleed has a rapid weak pulse and cold clammy skin. The nurse should:

रक्तस्राव के बाद रोगी की नाड़ी तेज़ व कमज़ोर है और त्वचा ठंडी व चिपचिपी है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Lay the patient flat with legs raised and prepare fluids as ordered
रोगी को पैर ऊँचे करके सीधा लिटाएँ और आदेश अनुसार तरल की तैयारी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Lying flat with the legs raised improves blood flow to vital organs while fluids are prepared

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Sit the patient upright
रोगी को सीधा बैठाएँ: Sitting up reduces blood flow to the brain

B — Give a hot bath
गर्म स्नान कराएँ: A hot bath worsens the low blood pressure

D — Withhold all fluids
सारे तरल रोकें: Fluids are the key treatment in shock

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Monitor the pulse, blood pressure and urine output closely in shock
option_1:
Sit the patient upright
रोगी को सीधा बैठाएँ
option_3:
Lay the patient flat with legs raised and prepare fluids as ordered
रोगी को पैर ऊँचे करके सीधा लिटाएँ और आदेश अनुसार तरल की तैयारी करें

question:
A patient with Cushing's syndrome typically has:

कुशिंग सिंड्रोम वाले रोगी में सामान्यतः क्या होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. A round face, a fat pad on the back and high blood sugar
गोल चेहरा, पीठ पर वसा की गद्दी और उच्च रक्त शर्करा

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Cushing's syndrome shows a round face, a buffalo hump and raised blood glucose

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Very low blood pressure
बहुत कम रक्तचाप: Blood pressure is usually high

B — Weight loss and low blood sugar
वज़न घटना और कम रक्त शर्करा: Weight loss and low glucose occur in adrenal insufficiency

D — Dehydration and thin skin only
केवल निर्जलीकरण और पतली त्वचा: Dehydration is not the main feature

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for infection and slow healing, because excess cortisol weakens immunity
option_2:
Weight loss and low blood sugar
वज़न घटना और कम रक्त शर्करा
option_3:
A round face, a fat pad on the back and high blood sugar
गोल चेहरा, पीठ पर वसा की गद्दी और उच्च रक्त शर्करा
option_4:
Dehydration and thin skin only
केवल निर्जलीकरण और पतली त्वचा

question:
After a liver biopsy, the nurse should:

यकृत बायोप्सी के बाद नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Position the patient on the right side and check for bleeding
रोगी को दाईं करवट लिटाएँ और रक्तस्राव की जाँच करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Right-side lying applies pressure to the biopsy site, and bleeding signs are checked

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ask the patient to walk at once
रोगी को तुरंत चलने को कहें: Early walking raises the risk of bleeding

C — Allow heavy lifting
भारी वज़न उठाने दें: Heavy lifting strains the site

D — Ignore any pain
किसी दर्द को अनदेखा करें: Pain may signal bleeding and must be assessed

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Report a rising pulse, falling blood pressure or abdominal pain at once
option_1:
Ask the patient to walk at once
रोगी को तुरंत चलने को कहें
option_2:
Position the patient on the right side and check for bleeding
रोगी को दाईं करवट लिटाएँ और रक्तस्राव की जाँच करें
option_4:
Ignore any pain
किसी दर्द को अनदेखा करें

question:
A patient with a venous leg ulcer is advised to:

शिरा-संबंधी पैर के अल्सर वाले रोगी को क्या सलाह दी जाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Elevate the leg and use compression as ordered
पैर को ऊँचा रखें और आदेश अनुसार कम्प्रेशन दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Elevation and compression improve venous return and healing

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Keep the leg hanging down
पैर को लटकाकर रखें: A dependent leg worsens swelling

C — Stand for long hours
लंबे समय तक खड़े रहें: Prolonged standing increases venous pressure

D — Avoid all dressings
सारी पट्टियों से बचें: Dressings protect and aid healing

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check the circulation of the foot when applying compression and remove it if the limb turns cold or blue
option_1:
Elevate the leg and use compression as ordered
पैर को ऊँचा रखें और आदेश अनुसार कम्प्रेशन दें
option_2:
Keep the leg hanging down
पैर को लटकाकर रखें
option_3:
Stand for long hours
लंबे समय तक खड़े रहें

question:
After spinal anaesthesia, the nurse should monitor the patient mainly for:

स्पाइनल एनेस्थीसिया के बाद नर्स को मुख्य रूप से किसकी निगरानी करनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Falling blood pressure, headache and return of sensation
गिरता रक्तचाप, सिरदर्द और संवेदना की वापसी

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Blood pressure, headache and return of sensation and movement are monitored after spinal anaesthesia

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — High fever only
केवल तेज़ बुखार: Fever alone is not the main concern

C — Rapid weight gain
तेज़ वज़न बढ़ना: Weight gain is unrelated

D — Increased appetite
भूख बढ़ना: Appetite is not the focus

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Keep the patient flat as ordered and check that sensation has returned before allowing activity
option_1:
Falling blood pressure, headache and return of sensation
गिरता रक्तचाप, सिरदर्द और संवेदना की वापसी

question:
A patient with a new colostomy should be taught to:

नए कोलोस्टोमी वाले रोगी को क्या सिखाया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Keep the skin around the stoma clean and dry and check the appliance seal
स्टोमा के आसपास की त्वचा साफ़ और सूखी रखें और उपकरण की सील जाँचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Clean, dry skin and a good seal prevent leakage and skin damage

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Apply soap directly on the stoma
स्टोमा पर सीधे साबुन लगाएँ: Soap on the stoma can irritate it

B — Ignore skin redness
त्वचा की लालिमा को अनदेखा करें: Redness may signal irritation or infection

D — Change the appliance only once a month
उपकरण महीने में केवल एक बार बदलें: The appliance is changed as needed to protect the skin

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: A well-fitting appliance protects the skin and gives the patient confidence
option_1:
Apply soap directly on the stoma
स्टोमा पर सीधे साबुन लगाएँ
option_2:
Ignore skin redness
त्वचा की लालिमा को अनदेखा करें
option_3:
Keep the skin around the stoma clean and dry and check the appliance seal
स्टोमा के आसपास की त्वचा साफ़ और सूखी रखें और उपकरण की सील जाँचें
option_4:
Change the appliance only once a month
उपकरण महीने में केवल एक बार बदलें

question:
A patient with peripheral arterial disease often has:

परिधीय धमनी रोग वाले रोगी में सामान्यतः क्या होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Pain in the calf on walking that eases with rest
चलने पर पिंडली में दर्द जो आराम से ठीक हो जाता है

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Intermittent claudication is calf pain on walking that eases with rest

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Swelling with no pain
बिना दर्द सूजन: Swelling without pain suggests venous problems

C — Pain relieved by standing
खड़े होने से ठीक होने वाला दर्द: Pain relieved by standing suggests a nerve or joint cause

D — Pain that is worse on lying down only
केवल लेटने पर बढ़ने वाला दर्द: Rest pain occurs in advanced disease

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Advise the patient to stop smoking, as it worsens arterial disease
option_2:
Pain in the calf on walking that eases with rest
चलने पर पिंडली में दर्द जो आराम से ठीक हो जाता है
option_3:
Pain relieved by standing
खड़े होने से ठीक होने वाला दर्द
option_4:
Pain that is worse on lying down only
केवल लेटने पर बढ़ने वाला दर्द

question:
A patient with glaucoma should be taught to:

ग्लूकोमा वाले रोगी को क्या सिखाया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Use eye drops regularly and avoid straining
आँख की बूँदें नियमित डालें और ज़ोर लगाने से बचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Regular eye drops and avoiding strain help keep eye pressure controlled

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Rub the eyes often
आँखें बार-बार मलें: Rubbing the eye can raise pressure

B — Drink large amounts of water at once
एक बार में अधिक पानी पिएँ: Drinking a large volume at once can raise eye pressure

C — Skip the drops when vision is fine
दृष्टि ठीक होने पर बूँदें छोड़ दें: Drops must be continued even when vision is fine

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Untreated glaucoma damages the optic nerve and can cause permanent blindness
option_2:
Drink large amounts of water at once
एक बार में अधिक पानी पिएँ
option_3:
Skip the drops when vision is fine
दृष्टि ठीक होने पर बूँदें छोड़ दें
option_4:
Use eye drops regularly and avoid straining
आँख की बूँदें नियमित डालें और ज़ोर लगाने से बचें

question:
A patient with encephalitis has fever, headache and drowsiness. The nurse should:

एन्सेफलाइटिस वाले रोगी को बुखार, सिरदर्द और तंद्रा है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Monitor the level of consciousness and vitals and keep the room calm
चेतना के स्तर और जीवन-चिह्न की निगरानी करें और कमरे को शांत रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Consciousness and vitals are monitored and a calm environment reduces stimulation

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ignore changes in consciousness
चेतना में बदलाव को अनदेखा करें: Changes in consciousness are important warning signs

B — Encourage vigorous activity
ज़ोरदार गतिविधि के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें: Vigorous activity is unsafe in an acute illness

C — Keep the room bright and noisy
कमरे को तेज़ रोशनी और शोर वाला रखें: Bright, noisy surroundings worsen headache and distress

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: A falling level of consciousness may signal raised pressure inside the skull
option_1:
Ignore changes in consciousness
चेतना में बदलाव को अनदेखा करें
option_2:
Encourage vigorous activity
ज़ोरदार गतिविधि के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें
option_3:
Keep the room bright and noisy
कमरे को तेज़ रोशनी और शोर वाला रखें
option_4:
Monitor the level of consciousness and vitals and keep the room calm
चेतना के स्तर और जीवन-चिह्न की निगरानी करें और कमरे को शांत रखें

question:
A common feature of hypothyroidism is:

हाइपोथायरॉइडिज़्म का एक सामान्य लक्षण क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Weight gain and feeling cold
वज़न बढ़ना और ठंड लगना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Hypothyroidism causes weight gain and intolerance to cold

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Excessive sweating
अत्यधिक पसीना: Sweating is reduced

C — Fast pulse
तेज़ नाड़ी: The pulse is usually slow

D — Weight loss and feeling hot
वज़न घटना और गर्मी लगना: Weight loss and heat intolerance occur in hyperthyroidism

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Thyroid replacement is taken on an empty stomach, and the dose is adjusted by tests
option_2:
Weight gain and feeling cold
वज़न बढ़ना और ठंड लगना
option_4:
Weight loss and feeling hot
वज़न घटना और गर्मी लगना

question:
To prevent infection in a patient with a urinary catheter, the nurse should:

मूत्र कैथेटर वाले रोगी में संक्रमण रोकने के लिए नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Keep the drainage bag below the bladder and maintain a closed system
निकास थैली को मूत्राशय से नीचे रखें और बंद तंत्र बनाए रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A closed system with the bag below the bladder prevents backflow and infection

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Clean the meatus with the same cloth used for the bowel
मूत्रमार्ग को आँत के लिए प्रयुक्त कपड़े से साफ़ करें: Using the same cloth causes contamination

C — Raise the bag above the bladder
थैली को मूत्राशय के ऊपर उठाएँ: Raising the bag allows urine to flow back

D — Disconnect the tubing often
नली को बार-बार अलग करें: Frequent disconnection breaks the closed system

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Remove the catheter as early as possible, because every day it stays increases infection risk
option_1:
Keep the drainage bag below the bladder and maintain a closed system
निकास थैली को मूत्राशय से नीचे रखें और बंद तंत्र बनाए रखें
option_2:
Clean the meatus with the same cloth used for the bowel
मूत्रमार्ग को आँत के लिए प्रयुक्त कपड़े से साफ़ करें
option_3:
Raise the bag above the bladder
थैली को मूत्राशय के ऊपर उठाएँ
option_4:
Disconnect the tubing often
नली को बार-बार अलग करें

question:
A patient with acute pancreatitis has severe upper abdominal pain and vomiting. The nurse should:

तीव्र अग्न्याशय शोथ वाले रोगी को ऊपरी पेट में तेज़ दर्द और उल्टी है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Keep the patient nil by mouth, give ordered pain relief and monitor vitals
रोगी को कुछ भी मुँह से न दें, आदेशित दर्द-राहत दें और जीवन-चिह्न की निगरानी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Resting the pancreas, giving adequate pain relief and monitoring vitals are the priorities

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give a large fatty meal
अधिक वसा वाला भोजन दें: Fatty food stimulates the pancreas and worsens pain

B — Give oral fluids freely
खुलकर मुँह से तरल दें: Oral intake is withheld in the acute phase

C — Encourage heavy activity
ज़ोरदार गतिविधि के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें: Activity increases pain and metabolic demand

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for shock and for a low calcium level, which can occur in severe pancreatitis
option_1:
Give a large fatty meal
अधिक वसा वाला भोजन दें
option_2:
Give oral fluids freely
खुलकर मुँह से तरल दें
option_3:
Encourage heavy activity
ज़ोरदार गतिविधि के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें
option_4:
Keep the patient nil by mouth, give ordered pain relief and monitor vitals
रोगी को कुछ भी मुँह से न दें, आदेशित दर्द-राहत दें और जीवन-चिह्न की निगरानी करें

question:
An older man with benign prostatic hyperplasia has difficulty passing urine. The nurse should:

सौम्य प्रोस्टेट वृद्धि वाले वृद्ध पुरुष को पेशाब करने में कठिनाई है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Record the urinary pattern and report retention
मूत्र त्याग के पैटर्न को दर्ज करें और मूत्र प्रतिधारण की सूचना दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The urinary pattern is recorded and retention is reported for treatment

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Restrict all fluids
सारे तरल रोकें: Fluid restriction does not solve retention and can harm the kidneys

C — Give a diuretic without orders
बिना आदेश मूत्रवर्धक दें: A diuretic without orders can cause harm

D — Ignore the difficulty
कठिनाई को अनदेखा करें: Retention can damage the kidneys and must be managed

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: A full bladder with an inability to pass urine is an emergency needing catheterisation
option_1:
Record the urinary pattern and report retention
मूत्र त्याग के पैटर्न को दर्ज करें और मूत्र प्रतिधारण की सूचना दें
option_3:
Give a diuretic without orders
बिना आदेश मूत्रवर्धक दें

question:
The most reliable site for measuring the core body temperature is the:

मूल शरीर तापमान मापने का सबसे विश्वसनीय स्थान कौन-सा है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Rectum
गुदा

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The rectal temperature is closest to the core temperature

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Mouth
मुँह: The oral reading is reliable but not the most accurate

B — Axilla
बगल: The axillary reading is the least accurate

C — Skin
त्वचा: Skin readings vary a lot

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Choose the site based on the patient's age, condition and safety

question:
While giving mouth care to an unconscious patient, the nurse should:

अचेतन रोगी को मुँह की देखभाल देते समय नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Position on the side and use only small amounts of fluid
करवट दिलाएँ और थोड़ी मात्रा में ही तरल उपयोग करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Side positioning and small amounts of fluid prevent aspiration

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Use a hard toothbrush forcefully
कठोर टूथब्रश ज़ोर से उपयोग करें: A hard brush can injure the gums

B — Lay the patient flat on the back
रोगी को पीठ के बल सीधा लिटाएँ: Lying on the back risks choking

C — Use large amounts of fluid
अधिक मात्रा में तरल उपयोग करें: Large volumes increase the risk of aspiration

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Inspect the mouth for sores and keep the lips moist during care
option_1:
Use a hard toothbrush forcefully
कठोर टूथब्रश ज़ोर से उपयोग करें
option_2:
Lay the patient flat on the back
रोगी को पीठ के बल सीधा लिटाएँ
option_3:
Use large amounts of fluid
अधिक मात्रा में तरल उपयोग करें
option_4:
Position on the side and use only small amounts of fluid
करवट दिलाएँ और थोड़ी मात्रा में ही तरल उपयोग करें

question:
A fluid balance chart records:

तरल संतुलन चार्ट में क्या दर्ज किया जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. All intake and output over a set period
निर्धारित अवधि में सारा सेवन और त्याग

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A fluid balance chart records all fluid intake and output

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only the medicines given
केवल दी गई दवाएँ: Medicines are recorded separately

C — Only the weight of the patient
केवल रोगी का वज़न: Weight is recorded in the chart but is not the whole chart

D — Only the temperature
केवल तापमान: Temperature is recorded elsewhere

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Accurate fluid charts help detect dehydration or overload early
option_1:
Only the medicines given
केवल दी गई दवाएँ
option_2:
All intake and output over a set period
निर्धारित अवधि में सारा सेवन और त्याग
option_3:
Only the weight of the patient
केवल रोगी का वज़न

question:
The correct order for removing personal protective equipment is to remove the most contaminated item:

व्यक्तिगत सुरक्षा उपकरण हटाने का सही क्रम यह है कि सबसे अधिक संदूषित वस्तु को कब हटाया जाए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. First, and perform hand hygiene at the end
पहले हटाएँ और अंत में हाथ की स्वच्छता करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The most contaminated item, such as gloves, is removed first, and hand hygiene is performed last

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Never remove it
इसे कभी न हटाएँ: Protective equipment is removed after use

B — Last, after everything else
सब कुछ के बाद सबसे अंत में: Removing it last spreads contamination

D — Only after leaving the ward
वार्ड छोड़ने के बाद ही: Removing it after leaving the ward contaminates the surroundings

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Hand hygiene after removing protective equipment is the final and essential step
option_2:
Last, after everything else
सब कुछ के बाद सबसे अंत में
option_3:
First, and perform hand hygiene at the end
पहले हटाएँ और अंत में हाथ की स्वच्छता करें
option_4:
Only after leaving the ward
वार्ड छोड़ने के बाद ही

question:
For a sputum specimen, the best time to collect is:

बलगम का नमूना लेने का सबसे अच्छा समय कौन-सा है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Early in the morning after rinsing the mouth
सुबह जल्दी, मुँह धोने के बाद

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Early-morning sputum after mouth rinsing gives the best sample

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Right after a meal
भोजन के तुरंत बाद: Food particles contaminate the sample

C — Before cleaning the mouth
मुँह साफ़ करने से पहले: Rinsing reduces contamination from the mouth

D — After a heavy exercise session
भारी व्यायाम के बाद: Exercise is unrelated

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Ask the patient to cough deeply so that the sample comes from the chest, not the mouth
option_1:
Early in the morning after rinsing the mouth
सुबह जल्दी, मुँह धोने के बाद
option_2:
Right after a meal
भोजन के तुरंत बाद
option_3:
Before cleaning the mouth
मुँह साफ़ करने से पहले
option_4:
After a heavy exercise session
भारी व्यायाम के बाद

question:
A cold pack is applied mainly to:

ठंडी पुल्टिस मुख्य रूप से किसलिए लगाई जाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Reduce swelling and numbing pain
सूजन कम करने और दर्द सुन्न करने के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Cold reduces swelling and numbs pain by narrowing the blood vessels

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Warm the body
शरीर को गर्म करने के लिए: Cold does not warm the body

B — Increase blood flow to the area
क्षेत्र में रक्त प्रवाह बढ़ाने के लिए: Cold reduces blood flow

D — Relax tight muscles deeply
कसे हुए मसल्स को गहराई से ढीला करने के लिए: Heat relaxes tight muscles

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Wrap the cold pack and check the skin often to prevent injury
option_1:
Warm the body
शरीर को गर्म करने के लिए
option_2:
Increase blood flow to the area
क्षेत्र में रक्त प्रवाह बढ़ाने के लिए
option_3:
Reduce swelling and numbing pain
सूजन कम करने और दर्द सुन्न करने के लिए
option_4:
Relax tight muscles deeply
कसे हुए मसल्स को गहराई से ढीला करने के लिए

question:
A patient is placed in restraints for safety. The nurse must:

सुरक्षा के लिए रोगी को बंधन में रखा गया है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Check the skin, circulation and need for restraint at regular intervals
नियमित अंतराल पर त्वचा, रक्त संचार और बंधन की आवश्यकता जाँचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Regular checks of the skin, circulation and continuing need protect the patient

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Use restraints for staff convenience
स्टाफ़ की सुविधा के लिए बंधन का उपयोग करें: Restraints are used only for safety, never for convenience

B — Tie the restraints tightly and leave them for hours
बंधन कसकर बाँधें और घंटों छोड़ दें: Tight, prolonged restraints cause injury

D — Ignore the patient's complaints
रोगी की शिकायतों को अनदेखा करें: Complaints may signal danger and must be heeded

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Document the reason, time and checks, and release the restraint as soon as it is safe
option_1:
Use restraints for staff convenience
स्टाफ़ की सुविधा के लिए बंधन का उपयोग करें
option_2:
Tie the restraints tightly and leave them for hours
बंधन कसकर बाँधें और घंटों छोड़ दें
option_3:
Check the skin, circulation and need for restraint at regular intervals
नियमित अंतराल पर त्वचा, रक्त संचार और बंधन की आवश्यकता जाँचें
option_4:
Ignore the patient's complaints
रोगी की शिकायतों को अनदेखा करें

question:
Before giving any care, the nurse should identify the patient using:

कोई भी देखभाल देने से पहले नर्स को रोगी की पहचान किससे करनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Two identifiers such as name and hospital number
दो पहचान जैसे नाम और अस्पताल नंबर

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Two identifiers, such as name and hospital number, ensure the right patient

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — The bed number alone
केवल बिस्तर का नंबर: The bed number alone is unsafe because patients move

B — The room colour
कमरे का रंग: Room colour is not an identifier

D — The patient's clothes
रोगी के कपड़े: Clothing is not an identifier

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Always check the identification band before medicines, procedures and blood products
option_1:
The bed number alone
केवल बिस्तर का नंबर
option_3:
Two identifiers such as name and hospital number
दो पहचान जैसे नाम और अस्पताल नंबर

question:
Effective discharge teaching should include:

प्रभावी छुट्टी शिक्षा में क्या शामिल होना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. The medicines, warning signs and follow-up plan
दवाएँ, चेतावनी संकेत और अनुवर्ती योजना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Medicines, warning signs and follow-up are essential parts of discharge teaching

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only the discharge date
केवल छुट्टी की तारीख: The date alone is not teaching

B — Only the diet
केवल आहार: Diet alone is incomplete

D — No written information
कोई लिखित जानकारी नहीं: Written information helps the patient remember

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Confirm the patient's understanding by asking them to repeat the instructions
option_1:
Only the discharge date
केवल छुट्टी की तारीख
option_3:
The medicines, warning signs and follow-up plan
दवाएँ, चेतावनी संकेत और अनुवर्ती योजना

question:
A woman with a twin pregnancy needs extra care because of a higher risk of:

जुड़वाँ गर्भावस्था वाली महिला को अधिक देखभाल चाहिए क्योंकि इसमें किसका खतरा अधिक होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Anaemia, preterm labour and high blood pressure
एनीमिया, समय से पूर्व प्रसव और उच्च रक्तचाप

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Twin pregnancy raises the risk of anaemia, preterm labour and high blood pressure

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Low blood pressure only
केवल निम्न रक्तचाप: Low blood pressure is not the main concern

C — Rapid weight loss
तेज़ वज़न घटना: Weight usually increases

D — No complications
कोई जटिलता नहीं: Complications are more, not fewer

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: More frequent check-ups help detect and manage these risks early
option_2:
Anaemia, preterm labour and high blood pressure
एनीमिया, समय से पूर्व प्रसव और उच्च रक्तचाप

question:
A woman in labour has a breech presentation with the membranes just ruptured. The nurse should:

प्रसव में महिला की प्रस्तुति उलटी (ब्रीच) है और झिल्ली अभी फटी है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Check the fetal heart and avoid a vaginal examination, then inform the doctor
भ्रूण हृदय जाँचें, योनि परीक्षण से बचें और डॉक्टर को सूचित करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The fetal heart is checked and a vaginal examination is avoided before informing the doctor

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Leave the woman alone
महिला को अकेला छोड़ दें: The woman needs continuous support and monitoring

B — Pull on the legs to hurry delivery
जल्दी प्रसव के लिए पैर खींचें: Pulling a leg can injure mother and baby

C — Ask the woman to push hard at once
महिला को तुरंत ज़ोर से धक्का देने को कहें: Pushing before full dilatation can harm the baby

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: A breech birth carries a higher risk, so prepare for a skilled delivery in a facility
option_1:
Leave the woman alone
महिला को अकेला छोड़ दें
option_2:
Pull on the legs to hurry delivery
जल्दी प्रसव के लिए पैर खींचें
option_3:
Ask the woman to push hard at once
महिला को तुरंत ज़ोर से धक्का देने को कहें
option_4:
Check the fetal heart and avoid a vaginal examination, then inform the doctor
भ्रूण हृदय जाँचें, योनि परीक्षण से बचें और डॉक्टर को सूचित करें

question:
A breastfeeding woman has a red, painful breast with fever. The nurse should advise her to:

स्तनपान कराने वाली महिला के स्तन में लालिमा, दर्द और बुखार है। नर्स को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Continue feeding, empty the breast and seek treatment
स्तनपान जारी रखें, स्तन खाली कराएँ और इलाज कराएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Continuing feeding, emptying the breast and getting treatment help resolve mastitis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Stop feeding the baby completely
शिशु को दूध पिलाना पूरी तरह बंद करें: Sudden stopping can worsen engorgement

C — Apply oil and massage roughly
तेल लगाकर ज़ोर से मालिश करें: Rough massage can spread infection

D — Ignore the fever
बुखार को अनदेखा करें: Fever needs prompt attention

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Good latch and positioning help prevent blocked ducts and mastitis
option_1:
Stop feeding the baby completely
शिशु को दूध पिलाना पूरी तरह बंद करें
option_2:
Continue feeding, empty the breast and seek treatment
स्तनपान जारी रखें, स्तन खाली कराएँ और इलाज कराएँ
option_3:
Apply oil and massage roughly
तेल लगाकर ज़ोर से मालिश करें

question:
Anti-D immunoglobulin is given to a Rh-negative mother mainly to:

आरएच-नकारात्मक माँ को एंटी-डी इम्युनोग्लोबुलिन मुख्यतः किसलिए दिया जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Prevent harm to future Rh-positive babies
भविष्य के आरएच-धनात्मक शिशुओं को हानि से बचाने के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Anti-D prevents the mother from forming antibodies that could harm future Rh-positive babies

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Increase her haemoglobin
उसका हीमोग्लोबिन बढ़ाने के लिए: It does not raise haemoglobin

C — Treat high blood pressure
उच्च रक्तचाप के इलाज के लिए: It is not a treatment for high blood pressure

D — Induce labour
प्रसव शुरू कराने के लिए: It does not induce labour

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Give anti-D at the recommended time after birth, bleeding or procedures, as ordered
option_1:
Prevent harm to future Rh-positive babies
भविष्य के आरएच-धनात्मक शिशुओं को हानि से बचाने के लिए
option_2:
Increase her haemoglobin
उसका हीमोग्लोबिन बढ़ाने के लिए
option_3:
Treat high blood pressure
उच्च रक्तचाप के इलाज के लिए

question:
The eyes of a newborn should be cleaned:

नवजात की आँखें कैसे साफ़ की जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. With separate sterile swabs, wiping from inner to outer corner
अलग बंध्य फाहों से, भीतरी से बाहरी कोने की ओर पोंछते हुए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Separate sterile swabs and inner-to-outer wiping prevent cross-infection

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — With one cloth for both eyes
दोनों आँखों के लिए एक ही कपड़ा: One cloth can pass infection between eyes

B — With the same swab back and forth
उसी फाहे से आगे-पीछे: Back-and-forth wiping can contaminate

D — Never cleaning them
उन्हें कभी साफ़ न करना: Eye care is part of newborn hygiene

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Report redness or a sticky discharge, which may mean eye infection
option_1:
With one cloth for both eyes
दोनों आँखों के लिए एक ही कपड़ा
option_2:
With the same swab back and forth
उसी फाहे से आगे-पीछे
option_3:
With separate sterile swabs, wiping from inner to outer corner
अलग बंध्य फाहों से, भीतरी से बाहरी कोने की ओर पोंछते हुए
option_4:
Never cleaning them
उन्हें कभी साफ़ न करना

question:
On a partograph, the cervical dilatation has stayed the same for four hours. The nurse should:

पार्टोग्राफ पर गर्भाशय ग्रीवा का फैलाव चार घंटे से वही है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Report it as slow progress and monitor mother and baby closely
इसे धीमी प्रगति के रूप में सूचित करें और माँ तथा शिशु की निकट निगरानी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A standstill in dilatation signals slow progress and needs reporting and close monitoring

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Turn off all monitoring
सारी निगरानी बंद कर दें: Monitoring must continue

C — Delay reporting until delivery
प्रसव तक सूचना देने में देरी करें: Delay risks the mother and baby

D — Ignore it as normal
इसे सामान्य मानकर अनदेखा करें: This is not normal progress

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: The partograph helps detect prolonged labour early, so that timely action can be taken
option_1:
Turn off all monitoring
सारी निगरानी बंद कर दें
option_2:
Report it as slow progress and monitor mother and baby closely
इसे धीमी प्रगति के रूप में सूचित करें और माँ तथा शिशु की निकट निगरानी करें
option_3:
Delay reporting until delivery
प्रसव तक सूचना देने में देरी करें
option_4:
Ignore it as normal
इसे सामान्य मानकर अनदेखा करें

question:
A woman taking oral contraceptive pills should be advised to:

गर्भनिरोधक गोलियाँ लेने वाली महिला को क्या सलाह दी जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Take the pill at the same time daily and not skip doses
रोज़ एक ही समय पर गोली लें और खुराक न छोड़ें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Taking the pill at the same time daily keeps the protection reliable

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Take two pills whenever one is missed
एक छूट जाने पर दो गोलियाँ लें: Doubling doses without advice is unsafe

C — Take them only when needed
केवल ज़रूरत पड़ने पर लें: Irregular use reduces effectiveness

D — Stop them without advice
बिना सलाह बंद कर दें: Stopping without advice loses protection

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: The pill does not protect against sexually transmitted infection, so the woman should be counselled accordingly
option_1:
Take two pills whenever one is missed
एक छूट जाने पर दो गोलियाँ लें
option_2:
Take the pill at the same time daily and not skip doses
रोज़ एक ही समय पर गोली लें और खुराक न छोड़ें
option_3:
Take them only when needed
केवल ज़रूरत पड़ने पर लें
option_4:
Stop them without advice
बिना सलाह बंद कर दें

question:
A common side effect of ACE inhibitor medicines is:

एसीई इनहिबिटर दवाओं का एक सामान्य दुष्प्रभाव क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. A dry cough
सूखी खाँसी

🧠 Clinical Rationale: ACE inhibitors commonly cause a persistent dry cough

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Blurred vision
धुँधली दृष्टि: Blurred vision is not typical

B — Hair loss
बालों का झड़ना: Hair loss is linked to chemotherapy

D — Tooth staining
दाँतों पर दाग: Tooth staining is linked to tetracyclines in children

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Report the cough, as the doctor may change the medicine to a related one that does not cause it

question:
Before giving sublingual nitroglycerin, the nurse should check the:

सबलिंगुअल नाइट्रोग्लिसरीन देने से पहले नर्स को क्या जाँचना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Blood pressure
रक्तचाप

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Nitroglycerin lowers blood pressure, so the pressure is checked before giving it

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Blood sugar
रक्त शर्करा: Blood sugar is checked for diabetes medicines

B — Temperature
तापमान: Temperature is unrelated

D — Urine output
मूत्र त्याग: Urine output is unrelated

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Tell the patient to sit or lie down when taking the tablet, as it can cause dizziness

question:
A patient on phenytoin should be monitored with:

फ़ेनिटोइन पर रोगी की निगरानी किससे की जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Blood drug levels
रक्त में दवा का स्तर

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Phenytoin has a narrow safe range, so blood drug levels are monitored

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Urine colour only
केवल मूत्र का रंग: Urine colour is unrelated

B — Blood sugar only
केवल रक्त शर्करा: Blood sugar is not the main monitor

C — Weight only
केवल वज़न: Weight is not the monitor for this drug

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Signs of too much phenytoin include unsteady walking and slurred speech
option_4:
Blood drug levels
रक्त में दवा का स्तर

question:
A patient on low-dose aspirin should be watched for:

कम खुराक एस्पिरिन पर रोगी की किस चीज़ के लिए निगरानी रखनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Bleeding and stomach irritation
रक्तस्राव और पेट में जलन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Aspirin can cause bleeding and irritation of the stomach lining

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — High blood sugar
उच्च रक्त शर्करा: High blood sugar is linked to steroids

C — Hair loss
बालों का झड़ना: Hair loss is linked to chemotherapy

D — Deafness
बहरापन: Deafness is linked to some antibiotics and diuretics

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Tell the patient to report black stools or stomach pain at once
option_2:
Bleeding and stomach irritation
रक्तस्राव और पेट में जलन

question:
A patient on furosemide should be monitored mainly for:

फ़्यूरोसेमाइड पर रोगी की मुख्य रूप से किस चीज़ के लिए निगरानी करनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Low potassium and dehydration
कम पोटैशियम और निर्जलीकरण

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Furosemide removes fluid and can cause low potassium and dehydration

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — High calcium
अधिक कैल्शियम: It does not mainly raise calcium

C — Weight gain
वज़न बढ़ना: It usually reduces weight by removing fluid

D — High potassium
अधिक पोटैशियम: It lowers rather than raises potassium

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Monitor the potassium level and watch for muscle weakness and cramps
option_1:
Low potassium and dehydration
कम पोटैशियम और निर्जलीकरण

question:
The main aim of disaster preparedness in a community is to:

समुदाय में आपदा तैयारी का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Reduce loss of life and organise a prompt response
जीवन की हानि कम करना और शीघ्र प्रतिक्रिया की व्यवस्था करना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Disaster preparedness reduces loss of life and ensures a prompt response

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Postpone all planning
सारी योजना टाल देना: Postponing planning is harmful

B — Increase the number of buildings
भवनों की संख्या बढ़ाना: More buildings do not reduce disaster impact

C — Avoid training of staff
स्टाफ़ के प्रशिक्षण से बचना: Training staff is essential

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Regular drills and a clear plan help the community respond quickly when disaster strikes
option_2:
Increase the number of buildings
भवनों की संख्या बढ़ाना
option_3:
Avoid training of staff
स्टाफ़ के प्रशिक्षण से बचना
option_4:
Reduce loss of life and organise a prompt response
जीवन की हानि कम करना और शीघ्र प्रतिक्रिया की व्यवस्था करना

question:
A community nurse can best help reduce tobacco use by:

सामुदायिक नर्स तंबाकू के उपयोग को कम करने में सबसे अच्छी सहायता कैसे कर सकती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Health education and supporting tobacco-free public places
स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा देना और तंबाकू-मुक्त सार्वजनिक स्थानों का समर्थन करना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Education and tobacco-free public places reduce tobacco use

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Selling tobacco cheaply
सस्ते में तंबाकू बेचना: Cheap tobacco increases use

C — Ignoring young people
युवाओं को अनदेखा करना: Young people are a key group to protect

D — Advertising tobacco
तंबाकू का विज्ञापन करना: Advertising increases use

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Screening and brief advice during home visits help people quit
option_1:
Health education and supporting tobacco-free public places
स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा देना और तंबाकू-मुक्त सार्वजनिक स्थानों का समर्थन करना

question:
Several people in a locality fall ill with fever and jaundice within a few days. The nurse should first:

कुछ दिनों में एक इलाके के कई लोगों को बुखार और पीलिया हो जाता है। नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Report the cluster and look for a common source such as water
समूह की सूचना दें और पानी जैसे साझा स्रोत की तलाश करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A cluster of fever with jaundice suggests an outbreak, so it is reported and a common source is looked for

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ignore the pattern
पैटर्न को अनदेखा करें: The pattern is the key clue and must not be ignored

B — Wait for more cases
अधिक रोगियों की प्रतीक्षा करें: Waiting allows the outbreak to spread

C — Treat only one patient
केवल एक रोगी का इलाज करें: Treating one patient does not control the outbreak

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Early reporting and source control prevent many more cases
option_2:
Wait for more cases
अधिक रोगियों की प्रतीक्षा करें
option_3:
Treat only one patient
केवल एक रोगी का इलाज करें
option_4:
Report the cluster and look for a common source such as water
समूह की सूचना दें और पानी जैसे साझा स्रोत की तलाश करें

question:
The best way to prevent occupational lung disease in a factory is to:

कारखाने में व्यावसायिक फेफड़ा रोग रोकने का सबसे अच्छा तरीका क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Control dust and provide protective equipment
धूल नियंत्रित करें और सुरक्षा उपकरण दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Dust control and protective equipment prevent occupational lung disease

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Remove ventilation
वेंटिलेशन हटाएँ: Ventilation reduces dust and must be kept

C — Allow smoking at the workplace
कार्यस्थल पर धूम्रपान की अनुमति दें: Smoking adds to lung damage

D — Increase working hours
काम के घंटे बढ़ाएँ: Longer hours increase exposure

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Regular health checks help detect early lung changes in workers
option_1:
Control dust and provide protective equipment
धूल नियंत्रित करें और सुरक्षा उपकरण दें
option_3:
Allow smoking at the workplace
कार्यस्थल पर धूम्रपान की अनुमति दें

question:
The main purpose of a referral system is to:

रेफ़रल प्रणाली का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Move a patient to the right level of care at the right time
रोगी को सही समय पर सही स्तर की देखभाल तक पहुँचाना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A referral system moves patients to the appropriate level of care in time

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Keep all patients at home
सारे रोगियों को घर पर रखना: Some patients need higher care

C — Increase travel costs
यात्रा खर्च बढ़ाना: The aim is not to raise costs

D — Avoid treatment
इलाज से बचना: The aim is to treat, not to avoid treatment

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Clear referral and back-referral links improve continuity of care
option_1:
Move a patient to the right level of care at the right time
रोगी को सही समय पर सही स्तर की देखभाल तक पहुँचाना
option_2:
Keep all patients at home
सारे रोगियों को घर पर रखना

question:
The simplest and cheapest way to make water safe at home is to:

घर पर पानी को सुरक्षित बनाने का सबसे सरल और सस्ता तरीका क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Boil it for a few minutes
इसे कुछ मिनट तक उबालना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Boiling water for a few minutes kills most organisms

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Add more salt to it
इसमें अधिक नमक डालना: Salt does not purify water at home levels

B — Add sugar to it
इसमें चीनी मिलाना: Sugar does not purify water

D — Store it in open pots
इसे खुले बर्तनों में रखना: Open storage allows contamination

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

Add more salt to it

Store it in open pots

question:
A newborn is lethargic, feeds poorly and feels cold. The nurse should suspect:

नवजात तंद्रालु है, ठीक से दूध नहीं पीता और ठंडा लगता है। नर्स को किसका संदेह करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Serious infection such as sepsis
सेप्सिस जैसा गंभीर संक्रमण

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Lethargy, poor feeding and cold skin in a newborn suggest a serious infection

🔍 Key Clues: newborn

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Normal behaviour
सामान्य व्यवहार: This is not normal newborn behaviour

C — Overfeeding
अति-भोजन: Overfeeding does not cause lethargy

D — Mild colic
हल्का पेट दर्द: Mild colic does not cause poor feeding and cold skin

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: A newborn with danger signs needs urgent referral and treatment, because sepsis progresses fast
option_1:
Serious infection such as sepsis
सेप्सिस जैसा गंभीर संक्रमण

question:
A child with asthma should be taught to:

दमा वाले बच्चे को क्या सिखाया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Use the inhaler correctly and avoid known triggers
इनहेलर सही तरीके से उपयोग करें और ज्ञात कारणों से बचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Correct inhaler use and trigger avoidance control asthma

A — Keep a pet in the bedroom
बेडरूम में पालतू जानवर रखें: Pets can worsen allergies and asthma

C — Stop all medicines when well
ठीक होने पर सारी दवा बंद करें: Preventive medicines are continued even when the child is well

D — Smoke with the child nearby
बच्चे के पास धूम्रपान करें: Second-hand smoke triggers attacks

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: A written action plan helps the family act early when symptoms worsen

बेडरूम में पालतू जानवर रखें

इनहेलर सही तरीके से उपयोग करें और ज्ञात कारणों से बचें
option_3:

ठीक होने पर सारी दवा बंद करें
option_4:
Smoke with the child nearby
बच्चे के पास धूम्रपान करें

question:
A child is very pale and breathless with a rapid pulse. The nurse should:

बच्चा बहुत पीला है, साँस फूलती है और नाड़ी तेज़ है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Give oxygen and prepare for urgent treatment and transfusion as ordered
ऑक्सीजन दें और आदेश अनुसार शीघ्र उपचार तथा रक्त आधान की तैयारी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Severe anaemia with breathlessness needs oxygen and urgent treatment as ordered

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ignore the breathlessness
साँस फूलने को अनदेखा करें: Breathlessness is a sign of a serious problem

B — Delay care until the next day
अगले दिन तक देखभाल में देरी करें: Delay is dangerous in severe anaemia

C — Give only iron tablets at home
घर पर केवल आयरन की गोलियाँ दें: Oral iron works too slowly for a severe case

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for heart failure, because severe anaemia strains the heart

option_3:

question:
A baby who had birth asphyxia should be watched closely for:

जन्म-श्वासावरोध झेल चुके शिशु पर किस चीज़ की निकट निगरानी रखनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Seizures, poor feeding and changes in consciousness
दौरे, खराब भोजन और चेतना में बदलाव

🧠 Clinical Rationale: After asphyxia, the baby is watched for seizures, feeding problems and a change in consciousness

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Increased appetite only
केवल भूख बढ़ना: Appetite usually falls

C — Rapid weight gain
तेज़ वज़न बढ़ना: Rapid weight gain is not expected

D — Loud crying only
केवल तेज़ रोना: Crying alone is not the key sign

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Early detection of brain involvement allows timely treatment and follow-up
option_1:
Seizures, poor feeding and changes in consciousness
दौरे, खराब भोजन और चेतना में बदलाव

question:
To prevent tooth decay in a young child, the nurse should advise:

छोटे बच्चे में दाँतों की क्षति रोकने के लिए नर्स को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Avoid sweets at bedtime and clean the teeth daily
सोते समय मिठाई से बचें और दाँत रोज़ साफ़ करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Avoiding bedtime sweets and cleaning teeth daily prevent decay

A — Never clean the teeth
दाँत कभी साफ़ न करें: Not cleaning allows plaque and cavities

B — Give sweets before sleep daily
रोज़ सोने से पहले मिठाई दें: Bedtime sweets cause decay

D — Give only sugary drinks
केवल मीठे पेय दें: Sugary drinks harm teeth

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Regular dental visits help detect decay early in children
option_1:
Never clean the teeth
दाँत कभी साफ़ न करें
option_2:
Give sweets before sleep daily
रोज़ सोने से पहले मिठाई दें
option_3:
Avoid sweets at bedtime and clean the teeth daily
सोते समय मिठाई से बचें और दाँत रोज़ साफ़ करें
option_4:
Give only sugary drinks

question:
Red bone marrow is mainly responsible for:

लाल अस्थि मज्जा मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए उत्तरदायी है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Production of blood cells
रक्त कोशिकाओं के निर्माण के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Red bone marrow produces blood cells

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Storing fat only
केवल वसा संचय के लिए: Yellow marrow stores fat

C — Producing bile
पित्त बनाने के लिए: Bile is produced by the liver

D — Filtering urine
मूत्र छानने के लिए: Urine is filtered by the kidneys

💎 PNC Pearl: Bone marrow problems can reduce red cells, white cells and platelets together
option_1:
Production of blood cells
रक्त कोशिकाओं के निर्माण के लिए
option_2:
Storing fat only

question:
Blood pressure is mainly regulated by the:

रक्तचाप मुख्य रूप से किसके द्वारा नियंत्रित होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Heart, blood vessels and kidneys
हृदय, रक्त वाहिकाएँ और गुर्दे

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The heart, blood vessels and kidneys work together to regulate blood pressure

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Stomach and intestine
आमाशय और आंत: The stomach and intestine are not the main regulators

C — Skin and hair
त्वचा और बाल: Skin and hair do not regulate pressure

D — Liver and lungs only
केवल यकृत और फेफड़े: The liver and lungs have other main roles

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Kidney disease often raises blood pressure, so both are monitored together
option_2:
Heart, blood vessels and kidneys
हृदय, रक्त वाहिकाएँ और गुर्दे
option_4:
Liver and lungs only
केवल यकृत और फेफड़े

question:
Most digestion and absorption of food occurs in the:

भोजन का अधिकांश पाचन और अवशोषण कहाँ होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Small intestine
छोटी आंत

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Most digestion and absorption happens in the small intestine

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Oesophagus
अन्नप्रणाली: The oesophagus only carries food down

B — Large intestine
बड़ी आंत: The large intestine mainly absorbs water and salts

C — Stomach
आमाशय: The stomach starts protein digestion

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Villi in the small intestine increase the surface area for absorbing nutrients

question:
The hormone that controls the growth of the body is secreted by the:

शरीर की वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने वाला हार्मोन किसके द्वारा स्रावित होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Anterior pituitary
अग्र पीयूष

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Growth hormone comes from the anterior pituitary

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Thyroid
थायरॉइड: The thyroid secretes thyroxine, which also affects growth

C — Adrenal cortex
अधिवृक्क प्रांतस्था: The adrenal cortex secretes cortisol

D — Pancreas
अग्न्याशय: The pancreas secretes insulin

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: A lack or excess of growth hormone in childhood affects final height

question:
The part of the ear that transmits sound vibrations to the inner ear is the:

कान का वह भाग जो ध्वनि कंपन को भीतरी कान तक पहुँचाता है, कौन-सा है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Middle ear
मध्य कान

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The middle ear, with its small bones, transmits vibrations to the inner ear

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Pinna
बाहरी कान (पिन्ना): The pinna collects sound

B — Eustachian tube
यूस्टेशियन नलिका: The eustachian tube equalises pressure

C — Ear canal
कान की नली: The ear canal carries sound inward

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Repeated ear infection can damage the middle ear and reduce hearing

question:
A patient is overactive, talks very fast and sleeps very little. The nurse should:

रोगी अत्यधिक सक्रिय है, बहुत तेज़ बोलता है और बहुत कम सोता है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Reduce stimulation, ensure safety and give ordered medicines
उत्तेजना कम करें, सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करें और आदेशित दवाएँ दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Reducing stimulation, ensuring safety and giving ordered medicines are the priorities in mania

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Leave the patient unsupervised
रोगी को बिना निगरानी छोड़ दें: Lack of supervision risks injury to self or others

C — Stop all treatment
सारा इलाज बंद करें: Stopping treatment is harmful

D — Encourage loud group activities
तेज़ समूह गतिविधियों के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें: Loud activities increase overactivity

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: A calm, low-stimulus environment and firm, kind limits help the patient settle
option_1:
Reduce stimulation, ensure safety and give ordered medicines
उत्तेजना कम करें, सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करें और आदेशित दवाएँ दें
option_2:
Leave the patient unsupervised
रोगी को बिना निगरानी छोड़ दें
option_4:
Encourage loud group activities
तेज़ समूह गतिविधियों के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें

question:
A patient admitted for alcohol dependence should also be given:

शराब की नशेड़ी अवस्था के लिए भर्ती रोगी को अतिरिक्त रूप से क्या दिया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Thiamine as ordered and a balanced diet
आदेश अनुसार थायमिन और संतुलित आहार

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Thiamine and a balanced diet help prevent neurological damage in alcohol dependence

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — No vitamins at all
कोई विटामिन नहीं: Vitamins are needed, especially B1

B — Only strong coffee
केवल कड़क कॉफ़ी: Coffee does not replace vitamins

D — A high-sugar drink only
केवल मीठा पेय: A sugary drink alone is not enough

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: Thiamine is given before glucose to reduce the risk of brain damage
option_3:
Thiamine as ordered and a balanced diet
आदेश अनुसार थायमिन और संतुलित आहार

question:
A therapeutic environment for a mentally ill patient means a place that is:

मानसिक रूप से बीमार रोगी के लिए चिकित्सीय वातावरण का अर्थ कैसा स्थान है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Safe, calm and supportive
सुरक्षित, शांत और सहायक

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A therapeutic environment is safe, calm and supportive

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Noisy and crowded
शोरगुल और भीड़ वाला: Noise and crowding worsen symptoms

C — Fearful and threatening
डरावना और धमकी भरा: Fear and threats harm recovery

D — Totally unorganised
पूरी तरह अव्यवस्थित: Lack of structure worsens distress

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: A structured daily routine helps patients feel secure and gain confidence
option_1:
Safe, calm and supportive
सुरक्षित, शांत और सहायक

question:
In crisis intervention, the nurse's main aim is to:

संकट हस्तक्षेप में नर्स का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Help the patient return to the previous level of functioning quickly
रोगी को शीघ्र पूर्व कार्य-स्तर पर लौटने में सहायता करना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Crisis intervention focuses on restoring the previous level of functioning quickly

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Avoid any support
किसी भी सहायता से बचना: Support is the core of crisis work

C — Explain long-term childhood issues over weeks
हफ़्तों में बचपन की समस्याएँ समझाना: Deep long-term work comes later, not in the crisis itself

D — Prescribe medicines at once
तुरंत दवा लिखना: Medicine is only one part, if ordered

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: A focused, here-and-now approach helps the patient regain control
option_1:
Avoid any support
किसी भी सहायता से बचना
option_2:
Help the patient return to the previous level of functioning quickly
रोगी को शीघ्र पूर्व कार्य-स्तर पर लौटने में सहायता करना
option_3:
Explain long-term childhood issues over weeks
हफ़्तों में बचपन की समस्याएँ समझाना

question:
The difference between sterilisation and disinfection is that sterilisation:

बंध्यकरण और कीटाणुशोधन में अंतर यह है कि बंध्यकरण:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Destroys all organisms including spores
सभी सूक्ष्मजीवों को, बीजाणुओं सहित, नष्ट करता है

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Sterilisation destroys all organisms, including spores, while disinfection may not

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Kills only some bacteria
केवल कुछ जीवाणु मारता है: Disinfection reduces but may not kill all organisms

B — Removes only dirt
केवल गंदगी हटाता है: Cleaning removes dirt but does not sterilise

D — Only reduces the smell
केवल गंध कम करता है: Reducing smell is not the aim

⚠️ Exam Trap: Separate sterilisation from disinfection, and bacteria from viruses - they are common distractors.

💎 PNC Pearl: Instruments that enter sterile body areas must be sterilised, not just disinfected
option_1:
Kills only some bacteria
केवल कुछ जीवाणु मारता है
option_3:
Destroys all organisms including spores
सभी सूक्ष्मजीवों को, बीजाणुओं सहित, नष्ट करता है
option_4:
Only reduces the smell
केवल गंध कम करता है

question:
A hospital-acquired infection is one that:

अस्पताल-जनित संक्रमण वह होता है जो:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Develops during or after admission and was not present at admission
भर्ती के दौरान या बाद में होता है और भर्ती के समय नहीं था

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A hospital-acquired infection appears during or after admission and was not present before

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Is present before admission
भर्ती से पहले से ही मौजूद है: An infection present before admission is community-acquired

C — Occurs only in the community
केवल समुदाय में होता है: It is linked to hospital care

D — Is caused by food alone
केवल भोजन से होता है: It is not limited to food

⚠️ Exam Trap: Separate sterilisation from disinfection, and bacteria from viruses - they are common distractors.

💎 PNC Pearl: Hand hygiene and safe procedures prevent many hospital-acquired infections
option_1:
Is present before admission
भर्ती से पहले से ही मौजूद है
option_2:
Develops during or after admission and was not present at admission
भर्ती के दौरान या बाद में होता है और भर्ती के समय नहीं था
option_3:
Occurs only in the community
केवल समुदाय में होता है
option_4:
Is caused by food alone
केवल भोजन से होता है

question:
Oedema may be caused by:

शोफ (सूजन) किस कारण हो सकता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Poor venous return or low blood protein
खराब शिरा वापसी या कम रक्त प्रोटीन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Poor venous return or low blood protein causes fluid to collect in the tissues

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Normal blood pressure only
केवल सामान्य रक्तचाप: Normal blood pressure does not cause oedema

C — Regular exercise
नियमित व्यायाम: Regular exercise reduces, not causes, oedema

D — A balanced diet
संतुलित आहार: A balanced diet does not cause oedema

⚠️ Exam Trap: Distinguish acute from chronic, and reversible from irreversible, before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check for pitting and note the site and extent of oedema
option_2:
Poor venous return or low blood protein
खराब शिरा वापसी या कम रक्त प्रोटीन

question:
A reversible form of cell injury that causes swelling without cell death is called:

कोशिका की वह प्रतिवर्ती क्षति जो कोशिका-मृत्यु के बिना सूजन पैदा करती है, क्या कहलाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Cellular swelling
कोशिकीय सूजन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Cellular swelling is a reversible injury from which the cell can recover

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Complete necrosis
पूर्ण परिगलन: Necrosis is cell death

C — Apoptosis
एपोप्टोसिस: Apoptosis is programmed cell death

D — Malignant change
घातक परिवर्तन: Malignant change is uncontrolled growth

⚠️ Exam Trap: Distinguish acute from chronic, and reversible from irreversible, before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Removing the cause early, such as hypoxia, allows cells to recover from reversible injury

question:
Protein-energy malnutrition in children mainly results from:

बच्चों में प्रोटीन-ऊर्जा कुपोषण मुख्य रूप से किससे होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. A diet lacking protein and calories
प्रोटीन और कैलोरी की कमी वाले आहार से

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A diet short of protein and calories causes protein-energy malnutrition

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Regular meals
नियमित भोजन से: Regular meals prevent it

B — Too much fruit
बहुत अधिक फल से: Fruit alone does not cause it

C — Too much water
बहुत अधिक पानी से: Water does not cause it

⚠️ Exam Trap: Separate the deficiency disease from its dietary source - exams mix the two.

💎 PNC Pearl: Growth monitoring helps detect malnutrition early in children
option_4:
A diet lacking protein and calories
प्रोटीन और कैलोरी की कमी वाले आहार से

question:
A diet rich in fibre mainly helps to:

रेशे से भरपूर आहार मुख्य रूप से किसमें सहायक है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Prevent constipation
कब्ज़ रोकने में

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Fibre adds bulk to stool and helps prevent constipation

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Cause dehydration
निर्जलीकरण करने में: Fibre does not cause dehydration

C — Remove all vitamins
सारे विटामिन हटाने में: Fibre does not remove vitamins

D — Raise blood sugar
रक्त शर्करा बढ़ाने में: Fibre helps control rather than raise blood sugar

⚠️ Exam Trap: Separate the deficiency disease from its dietary source - exams mix the two.

💎 PNC Pearl: Whole grains, fruits and vegetables are good sources of fibre

question:
The best first step to resolve conflict between two staff members is to:

दो स्टाफ़ सदस्यों के बीच टकराव सुलझाने का सर्वोत्तम पहला कदम क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Listen to both sides calmly and discuss the issue privately
दोनों पक्षों को शांति से सुनें और मुद्दे पर निजी तौर पर चर्चा करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Listening to both sides calmly and discussing privately helps resolve conflict fairly

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Discuss it in front of patients
रोगियों के सामने चर्चा करें: Discussing in front of patients breaks dignity

B — Punish both staff at once
दोनों स्टाफ़ को तुरंत दंडित करें: Punishing both without facts is unfair

D — Ignore the conflict
टकराव को अनदेखा करें: Ignoring conflict lets it grow

⚠️ Exam Trap: Remember that delegation transfers the task but never the accountability.

💎 PNC Pearl: Early, open communication prevents small conflicts from harming patient care
option_1:
Discuss it in front of patients
रोगियों के सामने चर्चा करें
option_2:
Punish both staff at once
दोनों स्टाफ़ को तुरंत दंडित करें
option_3:
Listen to both sides calmly and discuss the issue privately
दोनों पक्षों को शांति से सुनें और मुद्दे पर निजी तौर पर चर्चा करें

question:
The main aim of material management in a hospital is to:

अस्पताल में सामग्री प्रबंधन का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Ensure the right supplies are available in the right quantity
सही मात्रा में सही आपूर्ति उपलब्ध कराना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Material management ensures the right supplies in the right quantity at the right time

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Store items that are never used
कभी उपयोग न होने वाली वस्तुएँ संचय करना: Unused stock wastes money and space

C — Increase wastage
अपव्यय बढ़ाना: Increasing wastage is undesirable

D — Stop all stock records
सारे स्टॉक रिकॉर्ड बंद करना: Stock records are essential

⚠️ Exam Trap: Remember that delegation transfers the task but never the accountability.

💎 PNC Pearl: Good stock control prevents both shortages and expiry of costly items
option_1:
Ensure the right supplies are available in the right quantity
सही मात्रा में सही आपूर्ति उपलब्ध कराना
option_2:
Store items that are never used
कभी उपयोग न होने वाली वस्तुएँ संचय करना
option_4:
Stop all stock records
सारे स्टॉक रिकॉर्ड बंद करना

question:
A study in which neither the participant nor the researcher knows who receives which treatment is called:

वह अध्ययन जिसमें न प्रतिभागी और न शोधकर्ता जानता है कि किसे कौन-सा उपचार मिल रहा है, क्या कहलाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. A double-blind study
एक द्वि-अंध अध्ययन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: In a double-blind study both the participant and the researcher are unaware of the treatment given

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — A pilot study
एक पायलट अध्ययन: A pilot study is a small trial run of the plan

B — A case study
एक केस अध्ययन: A case study examines one person in depth

D — An open study
एक खुला अध्ययन: In an open study everyone knows the treatment

⚠️ Exam Trap: In research questions define the term precisely - reliability, validity and sampling are often interchanged.

💎 PNC Pearl: Double-blind design reduces bias and strengthens the results

question:
The main purpose of a pilot study is to:

पायलट अध्ययन का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Test and refine the plan on a small scale before the main study
मुख्य अध्ययन से पहले योजना को छोटे पैमाने पर जाँचना और सुधारना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A pilot study tests and refines the plan on a small scale

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Replace the main study
मुख्य अध्ययन को बदल देना: It prepares for, not replaces, the main study

B — Recruit all the subjects
सभी प्रतिभागियों को भर्ती करना: It uses only a small number of subjects

C — Publish the final results
अंतिम परिणाम प्रकाशित करना: It does not publish final results

⚠️ Exam Trap: In research questions define the term precisely - reliability, validity and sampling are often interchanged.

💎 PNC Pearl: A pilot study reveals problems in the tool or procedure before the main work begins
option_1:
Replace the main study
मुख्य अध्ययन को बदल देना
option_2:
Recruit all the subjects
सभी प्रतिभागियों को भर्ती करना
option_3:
Publish the final results

option_4:
Test and refine the plan on a small scale before the main study

question:
The sodium-potassium pump maintains a high concentration of potassium:

सोडियम-पोटैशियम पंप पोटैशियम की उच्च सांद्रता कहाँ बनाए रखता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Inside the cell
कोशिका के भीतर

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The pump keeps potassium high inside the cell and sodium high outside

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Outside the cell
कोशिका के बाहर: Sodium is high outside, not potassium

B — In the blood plasma only
केवल रक्त प्लाज़्मा में: The pump works at the cell membrane

C — In the urine
मूत्र में: This balance is not set in the urine

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: This pump is vital for nerve and muscle function, including the heart
option_2:
In the blood plasma only
केवल रक्त प्लाज़्मा में

question:
Learning by watching others and copying their behaviour is called:

दूसरों को देखकर और उनका व्यवहार अपनाकर सीखना क्या कहलाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Observational learning
प्रेक्षणात्मक अधिगम

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Observational learning is learning by watching and copying others

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Memory loss
स्मृति-लोप: Memory loss is a loss of memory

C — Reflex action
प्रतिवर्त क्रिया: A reflex action is an automatic response

D — Instinct
सहज प्रवृत्ति: An instinct is inborn

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: Health professionals model good hand hygiene, which patients then copy

question:
Rapid urbanisation often affects health by:

तेज़ शहरीकरण अक्सर स्वास्थ्य को कैसे प्रभावित करता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Increasing overcrowding and pollution
भीड़भाड़ और प्रदूषण बढ़ाकर

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Rapid urbanisation increases overcrowding, pollution and the spread of disease

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Improving air quality for all
सभी के लिए वायु गुणवत्ता सुधारकर: Air quality often worsens

B — Reducing all diseases
सारे रोग घटाकर: It can raise the risk of some diseases

C — Removing the need for sanitation
स्वच्छता की आवश्यकता हटाकर: Sanitation becomes more, not less, important

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Urban health planning must address housing, water and waste management
option_1:
Improving air quality for all
सभी के लिए वायु गुणवत्ता सुधारकर
option_3:
Removing the need for sanitation
स्वच्छता की आवश्यकता हटाकर
option_4:
Increasing overcrowding and pollution
भीड़भाड़ और प्रदूषण बढ़ाकर
